Hi Kajal, welcome!  It's great to meet you. Thanks for coming in today. I've reviewed your resume and I'm impressed by your projects, especially the inventory management system built in Java.  You've also got a good foundation in front-end technologies with your work on the expense tracker.

To get started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within computer science, and what you're hoping to achieve in your career.

Your resume mentions using a custom data structure in your Inventory Management System. Can you tell me more about the specific data structure you chose and why you selected it over other options, such as a standard Java Collection framework class?

Kajal, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I've truly valued learning more about your experience and skills, and I found our conversation very insightful.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we'll be in touch within [ timeframe, e.g., the next week ] to let you know the next steps in the hiring process.  Thank you again for your interest in [Company Name]. We appreciate you considering us.
